name: Le Santa

features.name: Jackpot Boxes
features.description: Four bet-based jackpots that can combine.

review:
Smokey's Christmas heist. Wins become Golden Squares, and a Rainbow turns them into coins, clovers, Santa Sacks that collect visible values, or Jackpot Boxes. Then the squares switch on and reveal again, so one Rainbow can pay several times.

Jackpot Boxes add four fixed jackpots tied to your bet, which combine if more than one lands. The bonuses start with Silent Heist. 20,000x max – a step up from Le Fisherman. A perfect December game.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
